title: USF Taxonomy Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for the USF taxonomy catalogue (spec/taxonomies/taxonomy-catalog.json) and future taxonomy artefacts. Validates taxonomy families and taxonomies per the catalogue's taxonomyRules: each family declares governed ontology concepts, purpose, expected future taxonomies/vocabulary/schema dependencies, source inputs, and AI guidance; each taxonomy belongs to a family and declares classificationMode (classification-modes), lifecycle status (lifecycle-states), governed ontology concepts, categories, category rules, future vocabulary/schema dependencies, source inputs, and AI guidance. CLOSURE POLICY: families, taxonomies, and categories are closed; descriptive metadata blocks (currentRepositoryState, governance, taxonomyRelationships, vocabularyDependencies, reactSourceLearnings, externalStandardsInfluence, deferredWork, acceptanceCriteria) are deliberately-open extension points typed permissively in this draft and documented as such. Cross-record checks (unique family/taxonomy ids, every taxonomy in a known family) are validator-deferred per schema-authoring-standard section 24. lifecycleState draft; not active.

classificationMode.$comment: Canonical values from the vocabulary value set 'classification-modes'.

lifecycleState.$comment: Canonical values from the vocabulary value set 'lifecycle-states'.
